hardwareHubs.note: The Ascent Innovation campus near South Dakota Mines grew from a 2006 incubator and housed B9Creations, a 3D printer maker that started there in 2014.

makerspaces.name: Black Hills State University Innovation Lab
makerspaces.note: Campus makerspace with Formlabs and Prusa 3D printers, a 50W CO2 laser cutter, 3D scanners, and Arduino and Raspberry Pi kits, with no CNC listed.

programs.name: Ascent Innovation and David Lust Accelerator Building
programs.note: Startup space of about 25,000 square feet with mentoring and access to School of Mines interns, though the source does not describe prototyping equipment.

programs.name: South Dakota Mines entrepreneurship programs
programs.note: Offers an Entrepreneur-in-Residence program, a business plan competition, and an annual angel investor conference for university innovators.

specialties.name: Medical goods and devices
specialties.note: The state economic development office lists medical goods and devices among products South Dakota manufacturers ship worldwide.

specialties.name: Electronic display boards
specialties.note: The same state page lists electronic display boards as a South Dakota manufactured product.

specialties.name: Polymer films
specialties.note: The same state page lists polymer films as a South Dakota manufactured product.

specialties.name: Food and machinery manufacturing
specialties.note: State labor data reported food manufacturing with the largest share of manufacturing jobs, followed by machinery manufacturing.

support.name: South Dakota Manufacturing and Technology Solutions (MTS)
support.note: The state's NIST MEP center in Watertown, operated by Lake Area Technical College since January 2023, helping manufacturers cut costs, build workforce, and automate.
